mainEntity.name: How long does a typical basement finishing project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement finishing project depends on its complexity and size. A basic finish might take 4-8 weeks, while projects involving extensive plumbing, electrical work, or the addition of new rooms could take 10-16 weeks or longer. Our project managers provide a detailed timeline upfront, outlining each phase from design to final inspection, allowing you to plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement finishing timelines vary from 4-16 weeks or more, depending on complexity. Extensive plumbing, electrical, or new room additions extend the project duration.
